mapper.sql: id, family_id, owner_member_id, holder_member_id, holder_member_name, doc_type, doc_no, issue_date, expiry_date, file_id, remark, deleted, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO archive_document (id, family_id, owner_member_id, holder_member_id, holder_member_name, doc_type, doc_no, issue_date, expiry_date, file_id, remark) VALUES (#{id}, #{familyId}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{holderMemberId}, #{holderMemberName}, #{docType}, #{docNo}, #{issueDate}, #{expiryDate}, #{fileId}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM archive_document WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE archive_document SET holder_member_id = #{holderMemberId}, holder_member_name = #{holderMemberName}, doc_type = #{docType}, doc_no = #{docNo}, issue_date = #{issueDate}, expiry_date = #{expiryDate}, file_id = #{fileId}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE archive_document SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
